## Body

Supersedes the R1 global-live recovery-walk observation in native-holds-lifecycle-cost: F260 final head ed6720039f5c9d8c0f56d783f06194aeeace866c adds live.kind=jobs.kind. The recovery guard now seeks the existing partial jobs_dedupe_live by kind/origin/key and excludes failed history. Keep the recipient-failed-history scan and H+1 event commits in complete renewal cost.

Expiry is now a primary-key UPDATE returning identity, followed only for a matched failed park by one SELECT of delivered evidence and siblings, in one write transaction. The sibling seek uses all-state jobs_by_dedupe(kind,origin,key), excluding unrelated recipients/keys but still visiting historical copies of that message. Price this extra in-transaction worker hop separately from pool checkouts; it is not a second transaction.

Exact-source SQLite3.54.1 receipt:64 recovery UPDATEs beside2,000 unrelated live rows cost1,180,960 VM instructions in R1 versus9,728 in final code. Expiry eligibility cost48 instructions alone,49 with2,000 unrelated live plus2,000 unrelated failed rows,30,050 with2,000 expired SAME-key copies. Not live CPU/latency proof. CI44895613825/job136820493329/artifact14703643649:15 focused cases passed.

D-F260-4 is the existing accepted negative-expiry-settlement debt: recovered parks repeat a no-op expiry transaction each sweep until24h lookback drops them. New same-key-history cost and the manual-CLI pending-head H-ceiling nuance are C34 follow-ups, never extra final-round blocks. Use actual H rather than treating the new-send64 admission check as a universal memory ceiling.

magicWand: regression proof for negative terminal expiry settlement and parameterized same-key-history query-work receipts.
difficulties: C25 dependencies absent, boot not ready and quick gate red; exact-head CI is separate. Read-only review made no builds, mutants, receiver changes or deployment. Both role instances stay held until merge.
